note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved; ZInQ.Compiler.Natural.alpha a definition: AlphaEqns (also AlphaFormula) is the formula (C.2); the gadget lemmas state the replacements of <, | and congruence by equations with fresh witnesses, including the zero-modulus case, and alpha_spec that the compiled macro means the formula. The lemmas are proved without assumed hypotheses.

snippet.text:
def alpha (X b N : Ex) : NM NForm := do
  note .alpha
  let r ← fresh
  let s ← fresh
  let t ← fresh
  let u ← fresh
  let v ← fresh
  let w ← fresh
  let x ← fresh
  let y ← fresh
  let one ← constant 1
  let two ← constant 2
  andM [
    do lt (← constant 3) b,
    do pure (.eq (← addL [one, ← mulL [b, u, t]]) (← addL [← square u, ← square t])),
    do pure (.eq (← addL [one, ← mulL [b, s, r]]) (← addL [← square s, ← square r])),
    lt r s,
    do divides (← square u) s,
    do pure (.eq (← addL [v, ← scale 2 r]) (← mulL [b, s])),
    congruent b v w,
    congruent two u w,
    lt two w,
    do pure (.eq (← addL [one, ← mulL [w, x, y]]) (← addL [← square x, ← square y])),
    do lt (← scale 2 X) u,
    do lt (← scale 2 X) v,
    congruent x v X,
    do lt (← scale 2 N) u,
    congruent x u N]
